summary: Backend regression + v5 fixes fully verified. 19/20 tests pass, 1 intentional skip (documented dead-end scenario in test_v4 that has been superseded by test_full_match_chase_wins_and_sets_mom). Exit code 0. All 4 last-ball-wicket cases (A/B/C/D) pass; profile-picture enrichment propagates via /teams/{id} and /public/matches/{token}; public player stats endpoint returns 200 without auth and strips email/phone; DELETE match works for owner (200), non-owner gets 403, deleted match removed from GET/list/search; chase-completion works symmetrically when team_b bats first and team_a chases; all v4 sanity flows (auto MoM, tournament MVP, public events, maidens, global search scoping) still green.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1430 lines and starting to exceed the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into routers (auth, teams, tournaments, matches, public) in a future refactor.

The pre_state snapshot is persisted inside innings.events which balloons match documents — fine for a few overs, but for long matches consider dropping pre before store and rebuilding for undo on demand.
OTP_DEV_MODE returning dev_code in the response is correct for dev/preview; ensure OTP_DEV_MODE=false is set in prod so `dev_code` is never leaked.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_v5_additional.py (new — 5 cases: CASE B all-out, CASE C wicket-on-final-ball-and-overs-done, delete-match search regression, non-owner 403 flow, chase symmetry when team_b bats first)
seed_data_creation: Each test signs up a fresh phone number (dev OTP) and creates fresh teams/matches — no shared state. Prefixes: CAX_/CBX_/SR_A_/SR_B_/TEST_A_/TEST_B_ for cleanup identification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest.ini pins -n 2 --dist loadscope; to run serial use `-n 0` (NOT -p no:xdist). BASE_URL comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. OTP_DEV_MODE returns dev_code in send response; use fresh phone per test to avoid 30-second resend cooldown. New CASE B test uses 11 batters + 20 overs and alternates bowlers every over (needs_new_bowler required at over ends even while taking wickets).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no regressions. Fixes verified: (1) after a last-ball wicket the `_apply_ball_effects` sets needs_new_batsman=True but the subsequent completed-branch in record_ball clears both pending flags (needs_new_batsman/needs_new_bowler) → frontend won't hang on a picker; (2) _enrich_team_players hydrates fresh profile_picture_path from users collection on every /teams/{id} and /public/matches/{token} fetch → uploads propagate immediately; (3) /public/players/{user_id}/stats explicitly strips email/phone; (4) DELETE /matches/{id} does a hard delete → search/list/get all consistent; (5) chase-completion logic references the OTHER innings' completion regardless of which side (a or b) is chasing → symmetry holds.
